GSBG.description: Girder-Stress Diagram Batch Group (GSBG). A single flat record per key defining a bridge girder stress/force diagram batch group; DGRM_TYPE selects between beam stresses and beam forces/moments, and BSTRSCOMP/_7TH_DOF_TYPE refine the displayed component.

NAME.description: Group name of the girder-stress diagram batch group.

BATCH.description: Whether this is a batch group (batch generation of the diagram).

BODY_ELEM_GRUP_K.description: Key of the bridge/body element group to which the diagram applies.

ALLSTAGE.description: Generation option. false = Current Stage-Step; true = all Stages (Last Step).

BSTRSCOMP_SUB.description: Sub location for the display of stress, used when BSTRSCOMP is 6 (7th DOF). 0=Maximum, 1=1(-y,+z), 2=2(+y,+z), 3=3(+y,-z), 4=4(-y,-z).

MOMENT_COMP.description: Beam forces/moments component, used when DGRM_TYPE is 1. 0=Fx, 1=Fy, 2=Fz, 3=Mx, 4=My, 5=Mz, 6=Mb, 7=Mt, 8=Mw.

_7TH_DOF_TYPE.description: 7th DOF type, used when BSTRSCOMP is 6 (7th DOF). 0=Sax(Warping), 1=Ssy(Mt), 2=Ssy(Mw), 3=Ssz(Mt), 4=Ssz(Mw), 5=Combined(Ssy), 6=Combined(Ssz).

DGRM_TYPE.description: Type of result to diagram. 0=Beam Stresses, 1=Beam Forces/Moments.

SCALEFACTOR.description: Display scale factor for the diagram.
